text:
Ava (CEO): Quick follow-up from the Q&A—teams keep asking what to do when a launch hits unexpected rate limits. Can we create a short operator playbook people can reference? :question:

Samir (VP Product): Agreed. We need a compact checklist: what to collect, who to notify, and immediate mitigations. Not a long doc, just one page in the console.

Riley (Support): Triage checklist I use: account ID, start/end window, expected peak RPS, affected endpoints, SDK/lang, sample request, and whether they want invoice credit or platform credit. Paste that into the ticket.

Marco (SRE): Immediate mitigations: 1) route to fallback model (lower-cost/latency), 2) enable heavier caching for repeated prompts, 3) apply short temp_quota +30% for 10m if approved. Avoid blanket global throttles.

Jamie (Finance): Important: promotional credits don't change quotas. If a customer asks for higher throughput, Sales must sign a contract amendment or we do a temporary manual quota change + invoicing note.

Priya (Customer Success): Add a one-line script for CS: how to request a temporary quota bump from the console (what fields to fill). Also include expected SLA for review (standard triage: 2h).

Samir (VP Product): Gating rules we propose: auto-approve if delta <= 35% of base QPS and duration <= 600s and risk_score < 45. Anything else triggers manual review by Eng + CS. Put this on the console card.

DevOpsBot: System note: base write QPS per account = 100 req/s. Current burst bucket = +20% for 45s. Admin temp endpoint: POST /admin/temp_quota_request {account_id, delta_qps, duration_s, reason} -> returns request_id. Requires at least one approver.

Marco (SRE): Instrumentation ask: include a traffic sample (JSON array of 10 recent requests) and a correlation_id so we can trace in logs. That speeds up SRE response.

Riley (Support): I'll add canned replies and a form template in the console that pre-fills those fields. We can also add a checkbox if they want a billing liaison.

Jamie (Finance): I'll draft the billing blurb: "Credits are monetary only and do not modify quotas. For launch-related overage billing, Sales can request an invoice credit after review." Link to billing contact.

Ava (CEO): Action items: Riley -> console form + canned replies; Samir -> console one-pager with gating rules; Marco -> quick SRE playbook; Jamie -> billing blurb. Let's have a console draft by EOD Tuesday. Thanks. Closing unless objections. :rocket:
